reviews.text:
Reached out to Sycamore on 5/16 for a pruning of our ash tree, as well as treating it for ash bore. Jessica was great of calling me back and getting a free quote set up. She came out within a day or two and explained everything in detail. The quote was sent to us on the 20th and had issues of it coming in blank. Jessica resent it quickly on the 21st and we accepted both of the services which would be over $1200. Scheduling was a bit tricky to deal with. Had to call multiple times throughout our time working with them as they never tell you when they are going to come. Called on the 4th of June as we hadn’t heard anything regarding either service. They said we had been scheduled and just weren’t informed of it. Thought this was a simple mistake and understood. Joe came out on the 9th to treat our one Ash tree and then he pointed out we had a second baby one growing that he also offered to treat. He was super great to work with and helpful in explaining and answering questions. The pruning team came on the 10th to cut out the dead of our large ash tree. They were maybe here two hours between setting up their stuff, clean up, and trimming. Unfortunately they did only get 1/3-1/2 of the dead out of the tree. Seemed like they worked on one side and didn’t bother to go on the other side or look up in the tree. They also left dead limbs hanging on other limbs, which also defeated the purpose of them coming out and what we asked for. We gave them a call to let them know our concerns especially with the price we were going to be paying which was 850 for the pruning alone. Joe was great of coming out on the 16th first thing in the morning and he agreed that the job was not done satisfactorily and that we would be scheduled again. Fast forward to July 1st, today and we are still waiting for our job to be completed. Reached out again yesterday to see if we were going to be scheduled and they said they would add us for today. Still waiting for them to show. We thought the price we were quoted was fair and we were really happy with the treatment and initial discussions but now that we will be nearly 2 months of the initial conversations for this job is quite disappointing. Check their work before paying and make sure you are satisfied as they are quick to send out bills and ask for payment. Just disappointing with the service and lack of communication from this group in regards to pruning.

Update: came back out this afternoon and finished the job. Happy that they care about customers feedback and want to do a good job, makes you want to recommend them. Excellent job cleaning up all branches both times as well. Thank you guys for making it right!
reviews.ownerResponse: Glad we could get it done for you in the end. Sorry for all of the delays!
